etsy.title: Stage Rally Poster, SS4 Gravel Split Time Print, Funny Motorsport Wall Art, Racing Gift for Men
etsy.description:
A stage rally poster styled like a timing board: SS4, gravel, stage 04, split +0.3, and the verdict "not bad for a tuesday".

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall.

Generic rally design: no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: No split-time or timing-board rally posters surfaced; the nearest are a video-game poster with lap timers and an event poster listing stage data.
Stage-based rally prints name real events; this design uses a generic stage number only.
Amazon rally prints are real-car watercolors and paintings sold unframed in 8x10, 11x14, A3, and A2, pitched at garages and man caves.
Amazon titles stack plain words: "wall art", "unframed", "gift for car enthusiast"; no pace-note or co-driver humor prints seen.

research.notes: "stage rally poster" is a "seen" phrase in the keyword file, not confirmed indexed; chosen because STAGE/SS4 is the printed subject and it keeps this listing off the shared "rally car poster" lead. "split time print" is my own descriptive phrase without search evidence. Listing pages were not reachable (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results and research/keywords/rally.json only. No priceRange: snippets did not reliably separate physical prints from digital downloads.
